At the opening ceremony of the initial return of the Chinese language, Magnien-Ledesma, Cathy, Magic's senior marketing director, and Smith, MK, Wizards' global vice president of sales, jointly announced that starting from 2027, Chinese will return to the Magic table - early next year, the latest newcomer deck (Welcome Deck) will be launched in Chinese. This is the first official announcement of Chinese language products since Magic: The Gathering announced in 2024 that it would stop launching Chinese language products.

ja.title: BioWare共同創設者：EA幹部はゲームを作ったことがなく、スタジオの閉鎖は偶然ではない
ja.summary: 先週の水曜日、57歳のグレッグ・ゼシュクさんはカナダのブリティッシュ・コロンビア州中部のバビン川でニジマス釣りをしていたところ、BioWare氏死亡のニュースが流れた。ゼシュクは釣りに集中するため携帯電話の電源を切った。その日遅く、ゼシュクさんが川から別荘に戻ると、携帯電話にテキストメッセージが流れ込んでいるのに気づきました。 「10通近くのテキストメッセージを受け取りました」とゼシュクさんは語った。 「携帯電話の電源を入れるとすぐに、誰かが私にお悔やみのメッセージを送ってきたのが見えました。『BioWare に起こったことについて深くお詫び申し上げます』。当時の私の最初の反応は、『BioWare はなくなってしまった!』でした」 グレッグ ゼシュクの最近の写真 1995 年、ゼシュクはレイ ムジカおよびオーガスティン イェと共同で BioWare を設立しました。過去 30 年間にわたり、BioWare は「Baldur's Gate」、「Mass Effect」、「Dragon Age」などの高く評価されたゲームを数多く作成し、ロールプレイングを再定義してきました。

en.title: BioWare co-founder: EA executives have never made games, closing the studio is not an accident
en.summary: Last Wednesday, 57-year-old Greg Zeschuk was fishing for rainbow trout on the Babine River in central British Columbia, Canada, when news of BioWare's death spread. In order to concentrate on fishing, Zeshuk turned off his mobile phone. Later that day, Zeshuk returned to his vacation cabin from the river to find a stream of text messages pouring into his phone. "I received almost 10 text messages," Zeshuk said. "As soon as I turned on my phone, I saw someone sending me a message to express condolences: 'I am deeply sorry for what happened to BioWare.' My first reaction at the time was: 'BioWare is gone!'" A recent photo of Greg Zeshuk In 1995, Zeshuk co-founded BioWare with Ray Muzica and Augustine Ye. en.title: World of Warcraft turns out to be such a fun game, Recorder VOL.815

zh.summary: 当使用人工智能编码工具开发应用程序时，有必要用文本解释屏幕的布局以及按下按钮时会发生什么。因此，您可以在浏览器上组装与谷歌“Material 3 Expressive”兼容的部件，连接多个屏幕并通过实际点击检查操作，并将设计内容直接转换为AI编码提示。 “M3E Canvas”是一个免费的开源工具。阅读更多...

en.title: ``M3E Canvas'' is a tool that assembles the Material 3 Expressive screen in a browser, connects the screens together, taps to confirm, and uses it as a prompt for AI coding.
en.summary: When developing an app using an AI coding tool, it is necessary to explain in text the layout of the screen and what happens when a button is pressed. Therefore, you can assemble parts compatible with Google's ``Material 3 Expressive'' on the browser, connect multiple screens and check the operation by actually tapping, and convert the design contents directly into AI coding prompts. ``M3E Canvas'' is a free open source tool. read more...

Bret's YouTube video, published 10 years ago at the time of article creation, explains ``How to land a space shuttle.'' read more...
